answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 139 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can a Hanafi Pray in Congregation Following Shafi'i Timing? Question: I am a Phd student in Loughborough university, UK. In my research laboratory there are 3 other Muslims who pray with Jamaat according to Shafei timing, and I follow Hanafi Fiqh. Can I pray Jamaat with them or should I wait and pray later on Hanafi times alone? JazakAllah Answer ID: 139 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 379/J) If they offer the Asr prayer before misl-e-sani (according to Shafei prayer timing) then you can pray with them all prayers except the Asr. And pray Asr after misl-e-sani according to Hanafi prayer timing). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
